Sarah — thanks for the pass and the clear asks. We reviewed the PDF and appreciate the focused edits. I’ll summarize below and propose execution routing.

Redlines summary (accepted / needs minor follow-up):
- Order Form payment milestones: accepted as-is.
- Data retention (Section 7): suggest compromise language attached in OrderForm_CleanCopy_v1.docx — retention reduced to 24 months with an audit window; keeps Redwood operational caching carve-out.
- Indemnity (Section 12): exception on back-to-back indemnities; propose mutually-agreed cap tied to annual spend. We believe that is a close compromise; legal is ok to finalize with one short sentence change.

Execution / routing proposal (recommended):
1) Single DocuSign envelope (sequential): Jeff Baran (CFO, Brightwell) -> Sarah Kline (Brightwell Legal) -> Redwood authorized signer (Name: Benjamin Carter, VP, Finance)
2) Envelope settings: require date/time stamp, include "Witness required" checkbox (optional based on your internal policy), and attach the clean copy PDF inside the envelope.
3) Post-signature custody: final PDF uploaded to Drive folder (Contracts > Brightwell_BRW-2026-042) and pushed to S3 escrow bucket for redundancy (link & retention policy documented).
4) Clean-copy ownership: Redwood Legal will publish the executed MSA + Order Form as a single stamped PDF; we will also post the redline vs clean comparison to the Drive folder for audit.

Action items for Brightwell: confirm whether notarization is mandatory. If you need a wet-notary, let us know and we will convert to a manual sign flow for Jeff (Ben will coordinate logistics). If DocuSign is OK, Ben (copied) will build the envelope and send to Jeff's assistant.

HubSpot: I linked the deal (BRW-2026-042) — please confirm contact for the envelope routing (assistant or direct email).
